description: This Java source file defines an Android activity called ClickFunActivity. It sets up a user interface with a button and a TextView, where clicking the button makes the TextView visible and updates its text.

classes.name: ClickFunActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a button which, when clicked, reveals and updates a TextView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and defines the onClick behavior for the button.
